tips.text: Run the bounty that drops the part you are missing, not whichever is convenient.
Hit every stage bonus objective; it roughly doubles the mushrooms a run pays.
Target-farm the part you need on normal and take the Steel Path bounty only when its rotation matches that part.
Run the bounties solo; objectives scale with squad size and randoms fail the bonus objectives.
Call in Orokin Eye air support to mark mushrooms on the map.
Bring Volt with range and strength to clear fast, or Zenith to shoot through walls at the hidden objectives.
Critter Liberation is the fastest bounty, about three to five minutes solo, because the mushrooms sit on the objective path.
Bring a Verglas sentinel on normal difficulty; it clears the bounty while you collect.
Compost duplicate mushrooms and buy the samples you lack at 10 Fergolyte each to reach Rank 4 without farming one species.
Stop at Rank 4; Rank 5 only gates Captura scenes and an ephemera.
Treat Fergolyte as a slow safety net; the drop tables usually pay out before Rank 4 opens.
Spend early Fergolyte on Archgun Arcane Adapters and the arcanes first; buying 720 of parts you would likely drop anyway is the regret move.
Farm Argon Crystals only after you hold the Systems blueprint; they decay in 24 hours.
Expect a few hours to about a week of casual play; a loud minority needs 100 or more bounties.
Players who finish quickly and players who grind blind use the same method; the difference is luck, and many call the bounties a pleasant loop anyway.
